description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer (Data Analytics) 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 

 The Opportunity: 
 CACI is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to support the design, development, operations, and sustainment of mission-critical applications, data analytics products, and services. This role supports the full software development lifecycle, including application development, testing, deployment, cloud administration, system maintenance, data integration, and continuous improvement within a secure mission environment.
 The ideal candidate will bring strong full stack development experience, hands-on knowledge of AWS and DevOps technologies, and the ability to translate mission and business requirements into reliable, scalable technical solutions. You will work closely with Government stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to maintain existing capabilities while identifying opportunities for system enhancements and modernization.

 Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications and data analytics products, including data solutions, applications, APIs, and visualizations.
 Develop and maintain front-end, back-end, database, and supporting application components using documented and repeatable software and data engineering practices.
 Perform Operations and Sustainment (O&S) activities to maintain the reliability, availability, performance, and functionality of mission applications and supporting systems.
 Troubleshoot and resolve application, system, database, and infrastructure issues following reported outages, service degradation, or performance concerns.
 Develop and maintain application code and database configurations to meet operational, reliability, availability, and functionality requirements.
 Perform corrective, preventive, adaptive, and perfective maintenance of existing software and applications in accordance with Government requirements.
 Support Agile software development and maintenance activities, including enhancements and modifications to existing applications and feature sets.
 Develop and support APIs and RESTful CRUD services used to integrate applications, data, and supporting systems.
 Administer cloud environments, including C2S, AWS, and Cloud Foundry, and support continuous monitoring, operating system upgrades, software upgrades, patching, and system maintenance.
 Perform required software and server upgrades in accordance with NGA SWAP-approved versions and established configuration standards.
 Administer user account access requests, account provisioning, and related access management activities.
 Support annual Continuity Planning and Testing activities, including updates within the NOC CP Tool and preparation of required evidentiary documentation.
 Review and maintain software and configuration information within XACTA 360 and Service+ CMDB in accordance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements and the Enterprise Service Catalog.
 Identify system enhancements, new capabilities, concept demonstrators, and supporting capability business cases.
 Develop and provide technical training as new systems, enhancements, and capabilities transition into operational use.
 Provide technical guidance and leadership to project teams while effectively communicating with Government stakeholders, management, and senior leadership.
 Independently initiate, manage, execute, track, and report technical tasks and deliverables as required by the Government.
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Top Secret SCI clearance required, and polygraph preferred 
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
 Five or more years of software development and/or full stack development experience using technologies and tools such as:JavaScript and TypeScriptPythonNode.jsCommand-line tools such as NPMGitAWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, EBS, ELB, and related cloud technologies
 Working knowledge of object-oriented software design principles and development practices.
 Working knowledge of DevOps practices and system administration.
 Strong hands-on experience with software design, development, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and debugging.
 Experience developing or supporting APIs and RESTful CRUD services.
 Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across applications, databases, cloud environments, and supporting infrastructure.
 Demonstrated ability to identify system enhancements, new capabilities, concept demonstrators, and potential business cases.
 Experience providing technical support and communicating with leadership, management, customers, and internal and external stakeholders.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$86,600 - $181,800 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
